name: Essential amino acids + Ketoanalogues
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero
summary: Ketoanalogues of essential amino acids (Ketosteril and similar products) are a kidney-specific therapy: the Spanish label indicates them for adults with chronic kidney failure and glomerular filtration rate (GFR) 25 mL/min/1.73 m2 or less who are on a protein-restricted diet (40 g/day or less). Each tablet carries 50 mg of calcium, so serum calcium must be checked. There is no US FDA label.
kidney_function_basis: Spanish summary of product characteristics (ficha técnica) uses GFR in mL/min/1.73 m2 (indication threshold 25).
chip: Use only with GFR ≤25 + low-protein diet

bands.recommendation: Not indicated: the SmPC indication is chronic kidney failure with GFR 25 mL/min/1.73 m2 or less.

GFR 25 or less with dietary protein 40 g/day or less: 4 to 8 tablets three times daily with meals for a 70 kg adult, swallowed whole; started and supervised by a kidney specialist (SmPC). Above GFR 25: not indicated.
4 to 8 tablets three times daily with meals (70 kg adult) with a protein-restricted diet (40 g/day or less); continue while GFR stays below 25 and the diet is maintained (SmPC).

hd.text: Not addressed in the SmPC; the indication is non-dialysis chronic kidney failure on a low-protein diet. Use in dialysis is off-label; specialist decision.

pd.text: Not addressed in the SmPC; off-label in peritoneal dialysis. Specialist decision.

monitoring: Serum calcium periodically (each tablet contains 1.25 mmol [50 mg] calcium); reduce vitamin D, then the dose and other calcium sources if hypercalcemia occurs. Serum phosphate if taken with aluminum hydroxide. Adequate calorie intake. Contains phenylalanine (phenylketonuria) (SmPC 4.4, 4.8). Use only as an adjunct to a dietitian-supervised low-protein diet (40 g/day or less per label; KDOQI 2020: very-low-protein diet with ketoanalogues in metabolically stable CKD G3–G5 not on dialysis); monitor nutritional status (weight, albumin, intake). Watch calcium closely with calcium-based phosphate binders or calcitriol/alfacalcidol.

pediatric.approved_ages: No experience in children or adolescents (SmPC).

renal.recommendation: Not established in children; kidney dosing not applicable.

adult: Regulator source is the Spanish AEMPS ficha técnica (machine-translated by the retrieval tool); the German/Austrian SmPC may differ slightly in tablet counts. The SmPC gives no per-kg figure; '0.1 g/kg' style dosing in some PH inserts is not used here.
Bands ≥60 and 30–59 set to 'hide' (not indicated); 15–29 band shows the indicated dose, though GFR 25–29 is outside the indication.
HD/PD gray: SmPC silent. Some nephrologists use it on dialysis; flag for Dr. Rivero.

revision_log.change: Monitoring: adjunct to supervised low/very-low-protein diet only (KDOQI 2020); nutritional status; additive hypercalcemia with calcium binders/active vitamin D.
